environment.description: FastAPI service running on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. The service has an IAM role with s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::app-session-store-prod/*. S3 access is routed through a gateway VPC endpoint (vpce-9f8e7d6c5b) with a restrictive endpoint policy. The VPC endpoint policy uses a condition key aws:PrincipalOrgID combined with a StringNotEquals condition on s3:prefix that denies PutObject for any key matching 'sessions/*.pkl' unless the request originates from the CI/CD pipeline role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-pipeline-role). The task role attached to the ECS service is NOT the deploy-pipeline-role. Additionally, the endpoint policy includes a Deny statement for s3:PutObject when aws:ResourceTag/immutable equals 'true', and the bucket has object-level tagging enforced via S3 Object Lock in governance mode with a 24-hour retention.
